card.match: The Can-Am Connection (Rick Martel and Tom Zenk) defeated Bob Orton and The Magnificent Muraco (with Mr. Fuji) by pinfall
Billy Jack Haynes vs. Hercules (with Bobby Heenan) ended in a double countout
Hillbilly Jim, Haiti Kid, and Little Beaver defeated King Kong Bundy, Little Tokyo, and Lord Littlebrook by disqualification
Harley Race (with Bobby Heenan and The Fabulous Moolah) defeated Junkyard Dog by pinfall
The Dream Team (Greg Valentine and Brutus Beefcake) (with Johnny Valiant and Dino Bravo) defeated The Rougeau Brothers (Jacques Rougeau and Raymond Rougeau) by pinfall
Roddy Piper defeated Adrian Adonis (with Jimmy Hart) by submission
Danny Davis and The Hart Foundation (Bret Hart and Jim Neidhart) (with Jimmy Hart) defeated Tito Santana and The British Bulldogs (Davey Boy Smith and Dynamite Kid) by pinfall
Butch Reed (with Slick) defeated Koko B. Ware by pinfall
Ricky Steamboat (with George Steele) defeated Randy Savage (c) (with Miss Elizabeth) by pinfall
card.stipulation: Singles match for the WWF Intercontinental Championship

card.match: The Honky Tonk Man (with Jimmy Hart) defeated Jake Roberts (with Alice Cooper) by pinfall
The Iron Sheik and Nikolai Volkoff (with Slick) defeated The Killer Bees (B. Brian Blair and Jim Brunzell) by disqualification
Hulk Hogan (c) defeated André the Giant (with Bobby Heenan) by pinfall
card.stipulation: Singles match for the WWF World Heavyweight Championship

card.match: Brutus Beefcake, Jake Roberts, Jim Duggan, Randy Savage, and Ricky Steamboat (with Miss Elizabeth) defeated Dangerous Danny Davis, Harley Race, Hercules, The Honky Tonk Man, and Ron Bass (with Bobby Heenan and Jimmy Hart)

The Fabulous Moolah, The Jumping Bomb Angels (Itsuki Yamazaki and Noriyo Tateno), Rockin' Robin, and Velvet McIntyre defeated Dawn Marie, Donna Christanello, The Glamour Girls (Leilani Kai and Judy Martin), and Sensational Sherri (with Jimmy Hart)

The British Bulldogs (Davey Boy Smith and Dynamite Kid), The Killer Bees (B. Brian Blair and Jim Brunzell), The Rougeau Brothers (Jacques Rougeau and Raymond Rougeau), Strike Force (Rick Martel and Tito Santana), and The Young Stallions (Jim Powers and Paul Roma) defeated The Bolsheviks (Boris Zhukov and Nikolai Volkoff), Demolition (Ax and Smash), The Dream Team (Dino Bravo and Greg Valentine), The Hart Foundation (Bret Hart and Jim Neidhart), and The Islanders (Haku and Tama) (with Bobby Heenan, Mr. Fuji, Jimmy Hart, Johnny Valiant and Slick)

André the Giant, Butch Reed, King Kong Bundy, One Man Gang, and Rick Rude (with Bobby Heenan and Slick) defeated Bam Bam Bigelow, Don Muraco, Hulk Hogan, Ken Patera, and Paul Orndorff (with Oliver Humperdink)
